name: slack_get_channel_history
description: Get recent messages from a Slack channel or DM. Tries conversations.history first; on access errors, falls back to search.messages with in:#channel query (works enterprise-wide).

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Slack channel or DM ID to fetch history for.

parameters.name: --channel_name
parameters.description: Optional Slack channel name to resolve before fetching history.

parameters.name: --cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous result.

returns: JSON with ok, channel, messages list, has_more, method (conversations.history or search.messages), and response_metadata.
